evidence_queue.description: Half-burnt cigarette butt recovered near victim vehicle tire in unpaved dirt
evidence_queue.reasoning: Unpreserved epithelial cells on cigarette filter subject to rapid microbial breakdown in ambient heat (34°C). Immediate cold storage and nucleic acid extraction required.

evidence_queue.description: Highway Toll Plaza CCTV DVR Hard Drive (200m south of incident scene)
evidence_queue.reasoning: High probative value for establishing suspect route and timestamp confirmation. Drive must be imaged in write-blocked state.

evidence_queue.description: Empty glass liquor bottle with visible partial fingerprints on neck
evidence_queue.reasoning: Latent ridge impressions on non-porous surface. Moderate risk of smudging during physical transit.
Thermal print paper degrades under direct UV exposure, but secondary associative priority compared to biological DNA.
